The Calico Jack departs from 32nd street bayside, next to Jolly Roger Amusement Park and there is plenty of FREE parking along 32nd street. The Calico Jack Heaboat is fun for all ages! services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: Duration: Please arrive at your ticketed time (you do not need to arrive early) and plan on being at Back Bay Adventures for at least 1.5 hours. Paperwork and guide training are included in your ticketed time and will be completed 30 minutes before your 60 minute ride time. Our riding area is located as soon as you leave the dock, which means immediate ride time for you on our premium high speed Seadoo Jet Skis! The riding area (approximately 10 blocks) is calm/ spacious and away from the high volume traffic in the main channel. Back Bay jet skis are recommended for novice riders or experienced riders! Speed depends on a few factors: weight on the ski, water conditions, and wind conditions.
